page_title: GIR 1-3 RAY | Girona v Rayo Vallecano 15/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Javier Alberola interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Hugo Rincon (Girona).
90+4' A spell of possession for Rayo Vallecano in an attempt to control the game.
90+3' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' It's a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
85' A substitution has been made. Alvaro Garcia goes off and Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
84' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Girona.

83' Thomas Lemar (Girona) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
81' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Unai Lopez.
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Jorge de Frutos.
80' The corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is hurriedly cleared.
80' Surely that's handball by one of the Rayo Vallecano players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
79' Poor challenge! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for tripping and Javier Alberola blows his whistle. Girona earn a free kick.

73' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
72' There's an opportunity for Portu (Girona) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
70' Here is a change. Pedro Diaz is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
70' It will be a substitution. Thomas Lemar (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Yangel Herrera walks off.
69' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
67' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
66' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
65' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
64' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Augusto Batalla comes off his line to intercept.
62' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola saw the whole situation.
60' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
58' Michel has decided to substitute Daley Blind (Girona) and he is replaced by Vitor Reis.
58' Substitution. Arnau Martinez makes his way off the pitch and Hugo Rincon (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
57' 1 - 3 Goal! Viktor Tsygankov manages to prod the ball to Joel Roca (Girona) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:3.
56' That was close by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.

55' Wasted effort! Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
54' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
52' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
51' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
50' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a throw-in.
48' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

47' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
46' Half-time substitution. Luiz Felipe will not participate anymore and Pelayo Fernandez (Rayo Vallecano) is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Michel probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Yaser Asprilla. He is replaced by Portu (Girona).
46' The whistle blows and Javier Alberola starts the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' Goal disallowed! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) scores but Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.

45+4' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 3 Goal! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Martin Juan Carlos into the bottom right corner.
45' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Bojan Miovski as he is replaced by Vladyslav Krapyvtsov (Girona).
43' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is awarded a red card due to his behaviour.
43' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul. That is a penalty kick for Rayo Vallecano.
41' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
39' Good movement by Yaser Asprilla (Girona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

34' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
31' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
28' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
28' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Javier Alberola blows his whistle. David Lopez (Girona) commits a foul after dangerous play. Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick.

24' Yangel Herrera (Girona) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
23' Girona string together a series of short passes.
20' 0 - 2 Goal! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) scores after an assist by Jorge de Frutos that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:2.
18' 0 - 1 GOAL! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) scores easily from close in after he is presented with the ball on a golden platter after the goalkeeper slips. It’s 0:1.
16' David Lopez (Girona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
15' That's a clear yellow card. Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the book.
13' A thunderous effort from long range by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
11' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
11' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
10' A cross into the box from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
8' The ball is out of play. Girona will take a throw-in.
6' Michel decides to make a substitution. Daley Blind will be replaced by Vitor Reis (Girona).
5' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
4' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) picks up an injury.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Javier Alberola.
